description: 'OMP Expo, TypeScript and React Native architecture'
applyTo: 'app/**/*.ts,app/**/*.tsx,src/**/*.ts,src/**/*.tsx'

Use [OMP frontend architecture](../skills/omp-react-architecture/SKILL.md). Preserve Expo Router and the domain module boundaries. Reuse themed components and translated labels. Validate mobile and web behavior for changes that affect both.
